ns2:course.label: Options and Futures Markets
ns2:course.description: Introduction of options and futures markets for financial assets; examination of institutional aspects of the markets; theories of pricing; discussion of simple as well as complicated trading strategies (arbitrage, hedging and spread); applications for asset and risk management. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Most seats reserved for undergraduate Finance majors; some seats reserved for other CBA majors.
